name: Developing good study habits, such as making a schedule and reviewing regularly, can greatly improve our learning efficiency.
trans: 养成良好的学习习惯，比如制定计划和定期复习，可以大大提高学习效率。

name: As college students, we should learn to manage our time wisely so that we can strike a balance between study and rest.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该学会合理安排时间，从而平衡学习与休息。

name: Working in a study group allows us to exchange ideas and solve problems together.
trans: 在学习小组中学习使我们能够交流想法、共同解决问题。

name: Online learning provides us with flexible access to abundant resources, but it requires strong self-discipline.
trans: 在线学习使我们能够灵活获取丰富资源，但它需要很强的自律。

name: In a rapidly changing world, lifelong learning is essential for us to keep pace with the times.
trans: 在快速变化的世界中，终身学习对我们与时俱进至关重要。

name: College education should not only impart knowledge but also cultivate students’ critical thinking.
trans: 大学教育不仅应传授知识，还应培养学生的批判性思维。

name: It is important to put what we have learned in class into practice.
trans: 把课堂所学付诸实践很重要。

name: Setting clear goals can motivate us to spare no effort to achieve academic success.
trans: 设定明确目标能激励我们不遗余力地取得学业成功。

name: Overcoming procrastination is the first step toward effective learning.
trans: 克服拖延是高效学习的第一步。

name: We should relieve academic pressure in a healthy way instead of being overwhelmed by exam anxiety.
trans: 我们应该以健康的方式缓解学业压力，而不是被考试焦虑压垮。

name: Only by staying focused in class can we make full use of our time.
trans: 只有在课堂上保持专注，我们才能充分利用时间。

name: Taking an active part in class discussions helps us understand knowledge more deeply.
trans: 积极参与课堂讨论有助于我们更深入地理解知识。

name: It is widely acknowledged that good study habits play an important role in academic success.
trans: 众所周知，良好的学习习惯在学业成功中起着重要作用。

name: There is no denying that time management is essential for college students.
trans: 不可否认，时间管理对大学生至关重要。

name: Only by developing self-discipline can we improve our learning efficiency.
trans: 只有培养自律，我们才能提高学习效率。

name: As college students, we should make full use of learning resources and strike a balance between study and life.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该充分利用学习资源，并平衡学习与生活。
